name: agentsecret
description: Policy-bound secret broker for agents, with DPoP and durable authorization

scripts.build: npm run build:cli && npm run build:source-access && npm run build:web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:cli && tsc --noEmit && tsc -p cli/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p web/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p src/server/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.test: npm run build:cli && npm run build:source-access && npm run build:web && node --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/*.test.mjs && npm run test:turso-adapter && npm run test:node-conformance && npm run test:local-security
scripts.test:license-boundary: npm run build:cli && npm run build:web && node --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/license-boundary.test.mjs
scripts.test:local-security: tsx --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/git-pack.test.ts tests/git-http.test.ts tests/cli-confirm.test.ts tests/provider-credentials.test.ts tests/onepassword-service-account.test.ts tests/bitwarden-password-manager.test.ts tests/lastpass.test.ts tests/browser-executor.test.ts tests/docker-runtime.test.ts && npm run test:license-boundary
scripts.build:server: npm run build:cli && npm run build:source-access && npm run build:web && node web/scripts/build-server.mjs
scripts.prepack: npm run build:cli && npm run build:source-access
scripts.setup:supervisor: node -e "const { spawnSync } = require('node:child_process'); const { isAbsolute } = require('node:path'); const configDir = process.env.AGENTSECRET_CONFIG_DIR; if (!configDir || !isAbsolute(configDir)) { console.error('Set AGENTSECRET_CONFIG_DIR to an absolute directory shared with AgentSecret before running npm run setup:supervisor.'); process.exit(1); } if (process.platform !== 'darwin' || process.arch !== 'arm64') { console.error('The packaged supervisor install path is qualified for macOS Apple silicon.'); process.exit(1); } const result = spawnSync('cargo', ['install', '--locked', '--path', 'native/agentsecret-supervisor', '--root', configDir, '--force'], { stdio: 'inherit' }); if (result.error) { console.error('Unable to run cargo; install Rust before setting up the AgentSecret supervisor.'); process.exit(1); } process.exit(result.status ?? 1);"

author: AstronLab
